server.name: urban-heat-mcp-toolbox
server.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Toolbox for BigQuery Urban Heat Analytics

tools.name: predict_heat_offset
tools.description: Predicts microclimate heat offset (degrees F relative to city baseline) and feature attributions using BigQuery ML ML.EXPLAIN_PREDICT.
tools.statement: SELECT predicted_temp_offset_f, top_feature_attributions FROM ML.EXPLAIN_PREDICT(MODEL `a4i_climate.heat_offset_model`, (SELECT {{latitude}} AS latitude, {{longitude}} AS longitude, ({{latitude}} - 32.7767) * 111.0 AS northing_km, ({{longitude}} - (-96.7970)) * 93.0 AS easting_km), STRUCT(3 AS top_k_features))

tools.name: rank_candidate_sites
tools.description: Ranks census tracts combining BigQuery ML predicted heat offset with demographic vulnerability indicators (poverty, no-car transit dependency, elderly population).

limit.description: Number of top vulnerable sites to return (max 10)

tools.statement: WITH candidates AS (SELECT d.geo_id, d.tract_lat AS latitude, d.tract_lon AS longitude, d.total_pop, d.median_age, d.median_income, d.poverty_rate, d.no_vehicle_rate, (d.tract_lat - 32.7767) * 111.0 AS northing_km, (d.tract_lon - (-96.7970)) * 93.0 AS easting_km FROM `a4i_climate.tract_demographics` d WHERE d.total_pop > 1000) SELECT geo_id, latitude, longitude, total_pop, poverty_rate, no_vehicle_rate, predicted_temp_offset_f, ROUND((predicted_temp_offset_f + 3.0) * 1.5 + (no_vehicle_rate * 100 * 0.4) + (poverty_rate * 100 * 0.3), 2) AS composite_vulnerability_score FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL `a4i_climate.heat_offset_model`, (SELECT * FROM candidates)) ORDER BY composite_vulnerability_score DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

tools.name: analyze_heat_frequency
tools.description: Queries 7 years of NOAA GHCN daily weather station observations to calculate frequency of extreme heat days exceeding a temperature threshold.
tools.statement: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM observation_date) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT observation_date) AS days_recorded, COUNTIF(max_temp_f >= {{temp_threshold_f}}) AS days_above_threshold, ROUND(MAX(max_temp_f), 1) AS record_high_temp_f, ROUND(AVG(max_temp_f), 1) AS avg_summer_max_f FROM `a4i_climate.station_daily_temps` WHERE max_temp_f IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM observation_date) IN (6, 7, 8, 9) GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC

tools.name: audit_equity
tools.description: Compares demographic indicators of recommended sites against citywide averages to perform an algorithmic equity audit.
tools.statement: WITH city_baseline AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(median_income), 0) AS city_avg_income, ROUND(AVG(poverty_rate) * 100, 1) AS city_avg_poverty_pct, ROUND(AVG(no_vehicle_rate) * 100, 1) AS city_avg_no_vehicle_pct FROM `a4i_climate.tract_demographics` WHERE total_pop > 0), recommended_sample AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(median_income), 0) AS rec_avg_income, ROUND(AVG(poverty_rate) * 100, 1) AS rec_avg_poverty_pct, ROUND(AVG(no_vehicle_rate) * 100, 1) AS rec_avg_no_vehicle_pct, SUM(total_pop) AS total_population_served FROM `a4i_climate.tract_demographics` WHERE geo_id IN UNNEST({{candidate_geo_ids}})) SELECT * FROM city_baseline CROSS JOIN recommended_sample
